Dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/942)
The Clerk of the Peace undertakes to ask the consent of [Mr Portal](/person/1196)and the Magistrates at the Quarter Sessions - so there is no doubt that this will be right.[^1]
Could the little wood cut of the Ampfield fountain (in the [book](/place/124)) be inserted - And one view of the old Hursley Church would be liked
Otherwise the list is very satisfactory.
That likeness of [Mr Keble](/person/798) has never been published, and would be much preferred if we can have it.
Otherwise the one in Lock’s life

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: The letter refers to illustrations for [John Keble\'s Parishes](/book/247), which were to include a portrait of Sir William Heathcote hung in the County Hall in Winchester.
